stories.title: New VOLTA Infostealer Uses Claude, Gemini, and Kimi AI to Rank Victims by Financial Value
stories.description: VOLTA Windows infostealer uses multiple LLMs to rank stolen data by monetization value and sends AI-generated victim assessments via Telegram.

stories.title: TightVNC Pre-Auth RCE Vulnerability Lets Hackers Execute Code on Windows PCs, PoC Released
stories.description: A TightVNC Viewer vulnerability allows attackers to execute code on Windows PCs before the password prompt appears.

stories.title: Hackers Target 61 GitHub Repositories With Command Injection Attacks to Steal CI/CD Secrets
stories.description: A command injection campaign targeted 61 GitHub repositories through 83 malicious posts, executing commands in two GitHub Actions workflows.

stories.title: Hackers Drain Bitcoin Hot Wallets on BTCPay Servers, Users Urged to Shut Down Immediately
stories.description: BTCPay Server has issued an urgent warning after receiving reports that attackers were draining Bitcoin hot wallets on its servers.

stories.description: A critical certificate validation flaw in LXD and Incus could let remote attackers bypass login checks and take control of clusters and managed virtual machines.

stories.title: Hackers Steal About $2.7 Million From Polymarket Traders via Hijacked DebugBear Script
